name: Saraelv / Ovi Raishiin - Somashytta / Somajavri
description: Nordkalottleden 6: Saraelv / Ovi Raishiin to Somashytta / Somajavri.
waterSources: Remote mountain section; carry capacity and treat natural water unless a hut/service page confirms potable water.

facilities.name: Somashytta / Somájávrribarta
facilities.description: Open/simple Norwegian wilderness hut by Somájávri. Reisa says it accommodates about 4 people, has a wood stove and usually firewood, cannot be prebooked, and is owned by the Norwegian Agriculture Agency and managed in agreement with Statskog. Management-plan evidence indicates an open part plus locked service part and dry toilet/outhouse.
facilities.routeProximity: at start endpoint; about 10.6 m from route relation start

facilities.name: Somashytta dry toilet / outhouse
facilities.description: Dry toilet / pit latrine associated with Somashytta.

facilities.name: Sarafossen / Čáragorži / Saarakurkkii
facilities.description: Waterfall/gorge near the final descent into Reisadalen. Official/field sources describe a steep detour/viewpoint area and slippery rock/scree risk in rain.
facilities.routeProximity: near final descent; route passes close to the Sarafossen road/trail area

facilities.name: Saraelv road bridge

facilities.name: Ovi Raishiin visitor point
facilities.description: Official Reisa National Park visitor point with information, maps, posters, roofed seating, viewpoint, toilets, fire sites and nearby overnight cabin. Public outdoor area is available all year.
facilities.routeProximity: about 1.0 km from Saraelv route endpoint; official endpoint/access cluster

facilities.name: Ovi Raishiin public toilet
facilities.description: Public toilet at Ovi Raishiin visitor point; Reisa describes toilets as always open/tidy.

facilities.name: Ovi Raishiin parking
